summary: Nexentis Technologies Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement for a registered direct offering plus a concurrent private placement of warrants. The offering consists of 311,876 common shares at an aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $1.25 million (implying ~$4.00/share) and 311,876 warrants exercisable at $4.008 per share with a 5-year term. Closing is expected June 15, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is an ordinary shelf takedown and capital raise, not a special situation.
